tests.name: the stat unit overlay is drawing, so its numbers change

detail.note: a toggle issued once is a coin flip, and the frozen-frame guard cannot see it because the engine frame number keeps advancing while the numbers stand still.

tests.name: the founder's own /pa showcase put avatars in the world
the avatars /pa created can be found to be read

detail.note: matched on the WL_PA_ label the shipped path assigns, rather than on class -- the costume worn by the Dog and the AI Companions are the same class.

tests.name: every FIGURE mesh of every /pa avatar is out of global illumination, as shipped

detail.note: READ OFF THE ACTORS THE SHIPPED CODE CREATED, not inferred from a frame time. The default subobjects are left alone deliberately -- they are not the figure, and 3 of 198 is what that looks like.

tests.name: the shipped fix makes the frame measurably cheaper on the founder's own avatars

detail.note: both readings taken in THIS run at the same camera on the SAME avatars, so the comparison is not against a number from an earlier session on a differently loaded machine. The floor is deliberately well below the 170.57 measured on one avatar, because /pa shows a whole family and the machine's load is not controlled.
